name: Sandburst
body:
School evocation [earth]; Level druid 1, ranger 1

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, DF

Range 10 feet

Effect 10-ft.-radius burst centered on you

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Reflex negates; Spell Resistance yes

You unleash a blast of sand into an area around you, dealing 1d6 nonlethal damage and stunning affected creatures for 1 round. A successful Reflex save halves the damage and negates the stunning. If this spell is cast in a desert or on a beach where there is sand in your square, the damage is increased to 1d6 nonlethal damage per caster level (maximum 5d6) and the target is staggered on a successful save.
